quarterly_data.signal: AAOI's 8-K: on August 31, 2026 AAOI entered two lease agreements for two industrial buildings to be constructed in Houston, Texas, in the same industrial park as its three May 8, 2026 leases, intended for light manufacturing, warehouse and related ancillary uses: Building 4 (approximately 356,186 rentable square feet) and Building 5 (approximately 737,621 rentable square feet). The landlord constructs the buildings, with substantial completion anticipated approximately 16 months following the date of the leases; each lease has an initial term of 120 full calendar months.
quarterly_data.figure: 2 Houston buildings to be constructed: ~356,186 / ~737,621 rentable sq ft; completion ~16 months after lease date; initial term 120 months
